context:
Goal: each repo's page shows its plans on the Status tab.
Problem (goal): PR #1779 (open since Nov 8) makes build.py bake the roadmap block from a single-branch clone, where it baked nothing before, and makes stale_pages.py flag an empty block. The code is in claude-settings, not in a child repo. Banchi's page is blank although its roadmap branch has 146 steps; q_max and joyous have plans but no roadmap branch and no page. Retrospective's reading: each child page should build from its own git export branch alone, so a fresh clone with no account data shows a non-blank Status tab; this clashes with #2829, which makes the page database the one store with git as backup.
Based on (ruling): R44 (child repos follow claude-settings); your 11:53 CST note on the git export branches.
Departs from: main, where #1779 sits open and unmerged — c rebuilds its two scripts in claude-settings and adds a rebuild of each child page from its export branch.

options.gain: The scripts are fixed once, and each child page can be rebuilt from git alone.
options.how: A lane rebuilds the two script changes on main. Runner 11 then rebuilds the banchi, q_max and joyous pages from each repo's own git export branch.
options.label: Rebuild #1779 in claude-settings; runner 11 rebuilds each child page from its export branch (recommended)
options.lose: One claude-settings lane and three child-page rebuilds; the #2829 clash needs your word later.

options.how: PR #1779 closes; the blank Status tabs stay.
options.label: Close #1779; leave the child pages as they are
options.lose: Banchi, q_max and joyous keep blank Status tabs; a single-branch clone still bakes nothing.

reply: Corrected 11:59 CST Nov 13: the item said #1779 fixes child repos' pages. It does not. #1779 changes two claude-settings scripts (skills/roadmap/build.py and skills/waiting-page/stale_pages.py); runner 11 asked what it was and I read the PR. Your 11:53 CST pick a (with the note that all accounts' data is already exported to a branch on each child repo as plain git) was made on my wrong text, so I reopened this with new options. Your note stands as context.

shown.label: Rebuild #1779 in claude-settings; runner 11 rebuilds each child page from its export branch (recommended)
Close #1779; leave the child pages as they are

title: What should happen to PR #1779 (the roadmap block builds from a single-branch clone, and an empty block is flagged)?
why: Work in child repos needs your word.
